text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear intro-body-conclusion structure","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more cleanly structured into an introduction, body paragraphs, and a conclusion, which makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"quotes integrated from the article","quality":"source use","description":"The essay more directly incorporates source evidence and ties it to its claims, giving the argument a firmer basis in the text."},{"evidence":"paragraphs each begin with a distinct claim","quality":"focused development","description":"Each body paragraph stays centered on one reason against driverless cars, which keeps the support more focused and controlled."},{"evidence":"repeated explanation of why each quote matters","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay more consistently explains how the cited details support the position instead of just mentioning them."},{"evidence":"final wrap-up restates the claim","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending more clearly summarizes the position and closes the argument rather than simply trailing off."}]}
